simple.meaning: שְׂמֹאול (sᵉmôʼwl) appears 54 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 17 more, beginning at Genesis 13:9. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, firstborn, kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׂמֹאול (H8040) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שְׂמֹאול through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
